title.purpose: Page and section headers, always rendered in Dark Plum.

shadows.name: ambient-low
shadows.purpose: Diffuse hover glow under primary content cards.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid pill button for primary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #6a4053; color: #ffffff; padding: 0.75rem 2rem; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: Figtree, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #4b2738; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Outline pill button for secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: transparent; color: #6a4053; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: Figtree, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid #6a4053; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #6a4053; color: #ffffff; }

components.name: Text Input
components.css: .ds-input-text { background: transparent; color: #6a4053; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; border-radius: 1rem; border: 1px solid #c4acac; font-family: Figtree, sans-serif; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.2s; } .ds-input-text:focus { border-color: #6a4053; }

narrative.overview: The visual system is warm, inviting, and graceful, heavily inspired by high-end cosmetic and perfume branding. It leans into a soft, romantic palette of plums, dusty roses, and warm creams. The interface balances structural elegance with a mix of soft rounded rectangles for data entry, and highly tactile pill shapes for actions.
keyCharacteristics: **Soft geometries:** Extensive use of pill shapes for actions, and soft rounded rectangles (8-12px) for inputs and cards.
**Monochromatic warmth:** UI elements, text, and borders all heavily utilize the primary Dark Plum color instead of harsh blacks or greys.
**Ambient Depth:** Very soft drop shadows lift primary content cards, while sticky navigation elements utilize glassmorphism (translucency + background blur).
**Semantic Clarity:** Statuses use clear, bright semantic colors (green, yellow, red) as pill-shaped tags to stand out against the warm, muted palette.

rules.name: The No-Black Rule
rules.body: Pure black is avoided. Text, icons, and structural lines use Dark Plum to maintain the soft, warm aesthetic.

rules.name: The Soft Rectangle
rules.body: Forms have soft rounded corners (approx 8px to 12px radius). Text inputs, search bars, and form textareas are *not* pills. They are standard rounded rectangles.

dos: Do use pill shapes for all buttons and status tags.
Do use soft rounded rectangles for text inputs and search bars.
Do use Dark Plum (#6a4053) for primary text and headings instead of black or dark grey.
Do use ambient, soft drop shadows for main white cards.
Do use glassmorphism for sticky navigation bars.
donts: Don't use sharp corners for any element.
Don't use pill shapes for standard text inputs or textareas; reserve pills for actions (buttons) and metadata (tags).
Don't use pure black or stark dark greys.
